Title: Yrel Hotfix Patch #2
Subtitle: Hotfix
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: ETC ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Mosh Pit's sound effects will no longer continue to play if casting is interrupted after learning the Tour Bus Talent.

=== Heroes: Garrosh ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can no longer use Into the Fray to throw an allied Boss.

=== Heroes: Ragnaros ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could allow allied displacement Abilities to move Ragnaros while he was in Molten Core form.
